    elif k not in after_pos:

    else:

# Print all small objects
print("\nAll small objects:")
for n in after['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] < 100 and n['color'] not in ['b']:

        print(f"  {n['color']}: [{minr},{minc}]-[{maxr},{maxc}] px={n['pixels']}")
